ui_ux_usability_design_pass.auditSummary: The game already had helper modes, invalid badges, legal-target glow, ghost preview, table zoom and a mobile Mexe editor. The gaps were clarity, not capability: a greyed DONE that did not say why outside beginner/standard mode, a confirm button labelled with a cancel glyph, melds packed into the top-left of an empty table, a menu backdrop that read as a debug overlay, a 14-row flat settings list with COPY TEST LOG in it, and a rotate banner that told every phone player portrait was wrong.
shipped: DONE clarity: '✕ FEITO' prefix removed; the blocking reason is now live in every helper mode; beginner adds a three-line ✓/✕ checklist derived from canConfirmTurn's own result
state-aware objective copy: start / card-selected / played-tap-DONE / table-invalid / ready-to-confirm (src/core/objective.ts)
table layout: meld rows centred horizontally, block centred vertically when it fits (src/table/layout.ts)
meld magnifier given an enlarged hit rect - it was a ~7-unit tap target
menu + setup share one opaque wooden panel (menu-layout.woodPanel) instead of the translucent debug-looking rectangle
ONLINE (ALFA) -> SALA ONLINE / ONLINE ROOM with a small 'Teste alpha' line
setup: match summary line, single tap-to-change hint, replay seed moved behind an ADVANCED toggle, layout now hangs off the seat count
settings redesigned into a 7-row section menu (Mute / Game / Audio / Accessibility / Cosmetics / Advanced / Close) with COPY TEST LOG, RESET DATA and the build version under Advanced
rotate hint softened and shown only during a match
pause menu: reassurance subtitle, consistent uppercase captions
Mexe editor copy clarified (full-screen table editor / tap a meld to rearrange it)
build version exposed via vite define (__APP_VERSION__)
deferred: server-owned turn timers, presets, reconnect grace and timeout behaviour - the turn timer is still an unwired hook; a client-side timer would break the server-authoritative rule
AI difficulty / personality / speed / explanation settings - ai.ts has personalities but no difficulty model, so the settings would not change play
toolbar relabelling (Undo | Reset | Sort | More) - needs an overflow panel and moves controls the e2e suite targets by coordinate
online room summary, host marker, larger connection indicator, waiting timeout UI - held for one coherent online pass
wider quick-move set (split handles, merge melds, Tidy Table, return-my-new-cards) - each needs its own no-duplication/no-loss proof
meld tray art - centring removed most of the empty-table feel; trays are decoration on a layout that now reads correctly
testChanges: helperFlags: feitoReason ('live' | 'onAttempt') replaced by doneChecklist (boolean, beginner only)
objectivePhase gained a hasSelection argument and two new phases
SettingsRow is now the 7-row section menu; GameRow / AudioRow / AccessRow / AdvancedRow cover the sub-panels
debugApi.reasonLine exposes the rendered reason line so the checklist can be asserted from Playwright
cosmetics cycle clicks now poll for the persisted effect (clickCosmeticUntil) - the single-click version was flaky under parallel load on main as well
